test_title: PYST 49: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Ramesh purchased some items from a dealer on 19 November 2019. The bill generated was for ₹5,480. He had also purchased some items on 10 November 2019 having the bill value of ₹9,800. He cleared both the bills this time and paid the total amount in cash. If the dealer gives a scheme of 2% discount on the payments done within 10 days and 5% for the payments made in cash at the time of purchase, then find the amount paid by Ramesh on 19 November 2019.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Bill 1 (10 Nov to 19 Nov = 9 days gap) is eligible for a 2% prompt payment discount.

Bill 2 (purchased and paid on 19 Nov) is eligible for a 5% instant cash discount.

Total Amount = (9800 × 0.98) + (5480 × 0.95)

Total Amount = 9604 + 5206 = 14810

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Bill 1 value = ₹9,800 (Purchased on 10 November 2019)

Bill 2 value = ₹5,480 (Purchased on 19 November 2019)

Payment date for both the bills = 19 November 2019

Discount scheme 1 = 2% for payments cleared within 10 days.

Discount scheme 2 = 5% for payments made in cash at the time of purchase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab5ce2fbb27248408d0ff3600470ea8cf646c336df15a3eecee45ab2ef2f93cf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time gap for clearing Bill 1 = 19 November − 10 November = 9 days.

⇒ Since Bill 1 is cleared within 10 days, a 2% discount is applicable on it.

⇒ Payable amount for Bill 1 = 9800 × (100 − 2) / 100 = 9800 × 98 / 100 = ₹9,604

⇒ Bill 2 is purchased and paid on the same day in cash, making it eligible for the 5% discount.

⇒ Payable amount for Bill 2 = 5480 × (100 − 5) / 100 = 5480 × 95 / 100 = ₹5,206

⇒ Total amount paid by Ramesh = Payable for Bill 1 + Payable for Bill 2

⇒ Total amount paid = 9604 + 5206 = ₹14,810

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cash Discount vs Trade Discount

A trade discount is offered directly on the catalog price to encourage bulk buying, whereas a cash discount is offered on the invoice price to encourage early or prompt payments by the customer.

Effective Successive Discount

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are applied sequentially on a product, the effective overall discount is calculated using the formula: Effective Discount = a + b − (a × b) / 100 %.

Selling Price after Discount

The final selling price of an item after offering a discount of d% on the marked price (MP) is determined by the relation: SP = MP × (100 − d) / 100.
